svg.title: When the background job starts a run
svg.desc: Nextcloud's cron starts the background job of the app every five minutes at most. With scheduled synchronization off, it does nothing. Otherwise it takes the start or the end of the last run that synchronized, a scheduled run or one by hand, whichever is later, and a dry-run only while it is still running. When the interval has passed since then, the job starts a run; otherwise it waits for the next background job.
